user.title: Connect to ProfiLux
user.description: Choose an interface. GHL API (recommended, firmware 7.31+) — enable it first under System → GHL API in GHL Control Center / GHL Connect; talks the API over its WebSocket, gives richer data and per-sensor level states, but is read-only (no socket switching). HTTP / WebSocket — the raw SWMBus interface, which also allows socket on/off control.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check the host, credentials and interface.

init.title: ProfiLux options
init.description: These options add entities that write to the controller. Socket control (SWMBus interfaces) can override the automatic control of live equipment. GHL API control adds editable setpoints, feed pause / water change / maintenance and lighting — it needs the API set to full access on the controller. In GHL API mode, each sensor below can be pinned to a type (the API doesn't report it); leave it on "auto" to detect it from the name and a unit probe. Leave off what you don't need.

data.control_sockets: Enable socket control (on/off switch per socket — SWMBus only)
data.api_control: Enable GHL API control (setpoints, actions, lighting — needs full access)
